unit.note: This iterate's three affected pytest roots, full-root counts: shared/scripts/tests 464 passed/2 skipped; shared/scripts/tools/tests 559 passed/16 skipped/2 deselected; shared/tests 9176 passed/32 skipped/20 deselected. Independently, the F0 canonical suite runner (all 18 discovered units: every plugins/*/tests + the three shared/ roots + integration-tests) reported 18/18 GREEN in 4.8 min with diff-coverage 93% (>= 80% threshold) against origin/main.

integration.note: integration-tests unit: PASS in the F0 suite run (254.5s); no changes in this diff touch integration-tests directly.

e2e.reason: no browser surface; this is a release-time CLI tool invoked from a skill's markdown steps

smoke.reason: no startable server surface for a release-time CLI tool

behaviors.behavior: No config / empty published_manifests / absent key → clean no-op
Single declared manifest is written + reported changed: true
Several manifests, mixed already-current/needs-write
Step 5.4 stages exactly its own written paths (git add, manifest_pathspec)
--verify-commit reads the committed blob, passes when write landed in the commit
The regression itself: manifest bumped in the worktree but omitted from the release commit → verify-commit fails, tag never cut
behaviors.evidence: test_verify_commit_catches_omitted_manifest_regression — the card's exact failure mode, proven closed

behaviors.behavior: --verify-commit never re-reads the (mutable) config, even if edited or deleted after sync()
--verify-commit resolves the git-relative path when --project-root is a subdirectory of the git repo
Process exit code is 0 on ok, non-zero on any failure status (the &&-chain contract)
--verify-commit without --result-file is a hard CLI usage error
Standing check: no config → no-op; no releases yet → pass; matching manifest → pass
Standing check: drifted manifest → WARNING, never ERROR
Standing check: declared manifest missing at HEAD → WARNING
Standing check: malformed config → WARNING, never a crash
Declared file missing on disk → manifest_missing, distinct from no-manifests-declared
Path containment: absolute path, Windows drive path, .. escape all rejected
Path containment: symlink escaping project root rejected
Path containment: in-root symlink also rejected (not just escapes)
behaviors.evidence: test_in_root_symlink_also_rejected — closes Branch A openai finding #1

behaviors.behavior: Malformed config shape (bad JSON, non-array, non-object entry, missing/non-string path) → invalid_config
Two declared entries that canonicalize to the same file → duplicate_manifest_path
No manifests declared but --stage passed → manifest_pathspec: [], not omitted
--version rejects non-SemVer leading-zero forms (01.2.3, 1.2.3-01), not just malformed shape
A git status failure other than "not a git repository" fails closed (index lock, damaged repo)
Pre-existing dirty manifest before sync starts → manifest_dirty_before_sync, never folded into the release commit
Duplicate top-level "version" key → ambiguous_manifest_structure, never a guessed rewrite
A nested object's own "version" key is not mistaken for a root-level duplicate
behaviors.evidence: test_read_version_nested_version_key_is_not_a_false_positive — closes a false-positive risk found during design, not by an external reviewer

behaviors.behavior: git add staging failure after writes succeeded restores already-written bytes (stage_failed)
--version validated before any write (rejects leading v, whitespace, non-semver)
Unrecognized format value → unsupported_format, not a silent skip
package_json edge cases: missing version key, non-string version, unparseable JSON
Two-phase write: all entries validated before any is touched; a later-failing entry leaves an earlier-validated one untouched
behaviors.evidence: test_sync_missing_version_field_fails_closed_disk_untouched (entry a untouched when entry b fails preflight)

behaviors.behavior: Mid-sequence write failure restores already-written manifests' bytes
Re-running an already-released version is a success with changed: false, no write
Surgical single-value substitution produces a minimal diff
Surgical substitution escapes regex metacharacters in the current version (semver ./-/+)
Ambiguous surgical match falls back to full re-render, flagged reformatted: true
--dry-run reports without writing to disk
--dry-run --stage together still reports manifest_pathspec (as []), never a missing key
--verify-commit rejects a --result-file recording a FAILED sync's own output (status != "ok")
--verify-commit rejects a --result-file left over from a DIFFERENT prior release (version mismatch)
stage_failed unstages the declared paths (git reset) as well as restoring worktree bytes
--verify-commit fails closed with result_file_invalid, not a traceback, on a non-object/non-list-shaped --result-file
--verify-commit fails closed on a malformed manifests entry (missing path/format)
Path containment: a Windows NTFS junction (mklink /J, not just a real symlink) is rejected
behaviors.evidence: test_windows_junction_in_path_rejected — closes Stage 3 doubt-review D4; passes (not skipped) on the primary Windows dev machine, unlike the two symlink tests beside it

behaviors.behavior: A relative --result-file resolves against --project-root, not the process CWD
--verify-commit rejects a --result-file recording a --dry-run sync (nothing was actually staged)
A project declaring a lockfile (package-lock.json, out of scope per manifest-sync.md) is rejected, not silently accepted
behaviors.evidence: test_sync_unsupported_format_fails_closed — format validation rejects any value other than package_json, which is the actual mechanism guarding the out-of-scope boundary

behaviors.behavior: No regression across the three affected pytest roots
